verdict.rationale: Ramp ships a documented open-source CLI with an explicit `--agent` JSON output mode and `--no-input` flag for CI, OAuth client-credential login for headless/standalone agents, a sandbox environment for safe automated testing, webhooks for event-driven triggers, and a full API/OpenAPI surface with scoped OAuth — all confirmed live via probes (mcp.ramp.com OAuth metadata, openapi/developer-api.json). missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) case studies of production CI/headless pipelines using the CLI, and no community confirmation of scripted/scheduled agent runs in the wild.
